request.path: payout_batch_job -> app.services.payouts.create_batch(period_key=<today>), run in the worker container

note: SIMULATION of the schedule: in production the ARQ cron runs daily and makes a batch only on a payout day (Mondays when the policy says weekly). Here the same function was run for today's date so the capture can continue. Every caregiver with a verified account and at least the minimum balance gets a payout. ALSO SIMULATED just before: the 24 hour cool-down that saving the first account started (capture a-bank-account-set) was moved into the past in the database, standing in for waiting a day.
